concepts.title: Singular cohomology and the cup product
concepts.blurb: Cochains $C^n(X;\mathbb{Z})=\Hom(C_n(X),\mathbb{Z})$, the coboundary $\delta$, and the cup product $\smile\colon H^p\otimes H^q\to H^{p+q}$ via the Alexander–Whitney diagonal. Worked example: $H^*(T^2)=\Lambda[\alpha,\beta]$.

concepts.title: Mayer–Vietoris and Künneth
concepts.blurb: The long exact sequence of an open cover $X=U\cup V$ in cohomology, and the Künneth formula $H^*(X\times Y)\cong H^*(X)\otimes H^*(Y)$ over a field, with Tor corrections over $\mathbb{Z}$. Worked example: $H^*(\mathbb{CP}^n)=\mathbb{Z}[x]/(x^{n+1})$.

concepts.title: Poincaré duality
concepts.blurb: For a closed oriented $n$-manifold $M$, the cap product with the fundamental class $[M]\in H_n(M)$ is an isomorphism $H^k(M)\cong H_{n-k}(M)$. Lefschetz duality handles the case with boundary. Worked example: a genus-$g$ surface has $b_0=b_2=1$, $b_1=2g$.

concepts.title: De Rham cohomology and the de Rham theorem
concepts.blurb: On a smooth manifold $H^*_{\mathrm{dR}}(M;\mathbb{R})\cong H^*(M;\mathbb{R})$ via the integration pairing $\int\colon\Omega^k\otimes C_k\to\mathbb{R}$. The wedge product on forms recovers the cup product. Worked example: $H^1_{\mathrm{dR}}(S^1)=\mathbb{R}$ generated by $d\theta$.

concepts.title: Spectral sequences (introduction)
concepts.blurb: A filtered cochain complex produces pages $E_r^{p,q}$ with differentials $d_r$ of bidegree $(r,1-r)$. The Serre spectral sequence of a fibration and the Leray spectral sequence of a sheaf are the two main examples. Walk through the $E_2$ page of Serre for the Hopf fibration $S^1\hookrightarrow S^3\to S^2$.

concepts.title: Characteristic classes preview
concepts.blurb: Vector bundles carry cohomology classes that obstruct triviality: Stiefel–Whitney $w_i\in H^i(B;\mathbb{Z}/2)$ for real bundles, Chern $c_i\in H^{2i}(B;\mathbb{Z})$ for complex ones. The total class $w(\xi\oplus\eta)=w(\xi)\smile w(\eta)$ uses the cup product directly.
